items.item:
1. Two owner tabs correct one project from revision 3; the first is accepted,
   the second is refused as stale.
   Shows A04-2, A04-3. [witness: verification:registry_a04_second_tab_stale_revision_refused]
statements:
```text
answer(a) = first failing check of a in the order (1)..(6), else its effect   -- A04-1
for action a on record r in {Project, Customer} that may move r.revision:
  a.stated_revision != r.revision => refused, r unchanged   -- A04-2
  accepted and changed(r) and r keeps a revision   -- A04-3
                          => r.revision' = r.revision + 1
                             and r.last_changed' = now
  accepted erasure, anonymisation or deletion => r has no revision after   -- A04-4
  r has no revision and a.stated_revision present => refused as stale   -- A04-5
  accepted and not changed(r) => r.revision' = r.revision   -- A04-6
```

verdicts.item:
1. Two owner tabs correct one project from revision 3; the first is accepted,
   the second is refused as stale.
   Shows A04-2, A04-3. [witness: verification:registry_a04_second_tab_stale_revision_refused]
statements:
```text
answer(a) = first failing check of a in the order (1)..(6), else its effect   -- A04-1
for action a on record r in {Project, Customer} that may move r.revision:
  a.stated_revision != r.revision => refused, r unchanged   -- A04-2
  accepted and changed(r) and r keeps a revision   -- A04-3
                          => r.revision' = r.revision + 1
                             and r.last_changed' = now
  accepted erasure, anonymisation or deletion => r has no revision after   -- A04-4
  r has no revision and a.stated_revision present => refused as stale   -- A04-5
```

verdicts.why: The check establishes both tabs' stated revision as 3, verifies that the first correction is accepted and changes the project to revision 4 with last-changed set to the current instant, then verifies that the second correction stating revision 3 is refused as stale. It also detects any resulting record or audit-store change after the refusal.
